entities.summary: Valentin Valentinovich Zykov is a Russian professional ice hockey winger who is currently playing for SKA Saint Petersburg in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). He was selected by the Los Angeles Kings in the second round of the 2013 NHL Entry Draft.
